occupation.description: Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) implementation support: requirements, data modeling, wireframes, Software Requirement Specification (SRS), Standard Operating Procedure (SOP), and verification.
responsibilities: Conducted interviews and analyzed documents to gather user requirements for the development of an Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) system.
Created detailed business process documentation using flowchart diagrams.
Collaborated with back-end developers to design a relational database for the ERP system using entity-relationship diagrams.
Coordinated with front-end developers to create wireframes for system interfaces.
Collaborated with technical writers to develop the Software Requirement Specification (SRS) document.
Developed a Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) for ERP usage.
Verified the developed ERP system with users to ensure alignment with business processes and user requirements.
Prepared a comprehensive Functional Specifications Document (FSD).
occupation.skillsNote: ERP requirements, flowcharting, ERD, wireframes, SRS, SOP, FSD.
